harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, /tmp and /dev/shm were converted to tmpfs mounts with noexec,nosuid,nodev options, persisted in /etc/fstab, applied live, and verified to survive a full node reboot (boot id changed and hardened options/functional blocks confirmed post-restart).
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: /dev/shm was tmpfs with only nosuid,nodev (no noexec); /tmp was not a separate mount (part of root fs)
Backed up /etc/fstab, removed any pre-existing /tmp or /dev/shm lines, and appended hardened tmpfs entries with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,seclabel for both /tmp and /dev/shm
Applied changes live: remounted /dev/shm and mounted /tmp as tmpfs with the new options
Verified via findmnt that both mounts show nosuid,nodev,noexec
Functionally verified noexec by writing+chmod+x a script on each mount and confirming execution was denied (Permission denied)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline
Issued a native sudo reboot on node1 (single node, acknowledgement returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until command execution was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed (151c4aa9... -> 1c5cd563...), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart that /tmp and /dev/shm still have noexec,nosuid,nodev via findmnt and functional exec-blocked tests, confirming persistence via /etc/fstab

evidence.requirement: Baseline state of /tmp and /dev/shm before changes
evidence.summary: Showed /dev/shm mounted tmpfs with only nosuid,nodev (no noexec); /tmp not a separate mount; empty fstab entries for either

evidence.requirement: Hardened mount options (noexec,nosuid,nodev) applied live and persisted in /etc/fstab
evidence.summary: Added tmpfs /tmp and tmpfs /dev/shm fstab lines with noexec,nosuid,nodev; remounted both live; findmnt confirms options; functional test proves execution denied on both mounts

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline boot identity and mount/fstab state on node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a plus live mount options and fstab entries prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement for node1 (single node, native reboot)
evidence.summary: sudo -n reboot issued in background; connection dropped as node went down, confirming acknowledgement returned before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot window, then came back with boot_id 1c5cd563-e744-474d-9ceb-003a3f6116ef, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, and uptime reflects a fresh boot time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery/persistence of hardened /tmp and /dev/shm settings
evidence.summary: findmnt confirms both mounts retained noexec,nosuid,nodev after reboot (sourced from /etc/fstab), and functional execution tests on both mounts were denied post-restart

attempts.summary: On node1, /tmp and /dev/shm were converted to tmpfs mounts with noexec,nosuid,nodev options, persisted in /etc/fstab, applied live, and verified to survive a full node reboot (boot id changed and hardened options/functional blocks confirmed post-restart).
